The energy transition will require innovators, leaders, changemakers and dreamers. We need young people engaged: not afraid to ask questions and willing to tackle issues with a multi-perspective approach. That is why at the Youth Booth on the sideline of the IRENA Assembly, I challenged the IRENA youth participants to consider their own place in the energy transition. 

💡 How do they assess the role of youth in the energy transition?  

🌍 What could be the role of youth in the energy transition?  

⚡️ What are they doing to accelerate access to energy? 

We need disruptors and innovators to accelerate global clean energy transitions, not only entrepreneurs. Young people are already leading the sustainable energy revolution and developing clean energy solutions for their communities. We need to ensure that their voices can be heard at the forefront of this global transformation! #IRENA15A #EnergyforDevelopment #SustainableEnergyRevolution #Youth
